events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place over three days in upstate New York, becoming a defining moment of the 1960s counterculture.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and peace of Woodstock. What's your favourite moment from the legendary festival?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away at his Graceland home in Memphis, Tennessee.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering The King of Rock & Roll. 49 years since we lost Elvis Presley, but his music still reigns supreme.

events.title: Tupac Shakur Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas, Nevada.

angles.name: Tupac Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur. His impact on music and culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix died in London, leaving behind an unparalleled musical legacy.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Celebrating the genius of Jimi Hendrix. His guitar wizardry changed music forever.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', featuring iconic tracks and its famous zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. Which track is your absolute favourite?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: American singer-songwriter Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine', featuring the timeless title track, was released.

angles.name: Imagine Impact
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song whose message of peace and unity still resonates today.

events.title: First iPod Released Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod, revolutionising how people listened to music on the go.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years ago, the first iPod dropped and changed everything. What was on your first playlist?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and which theme tune gets you in the mood for espionage?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles' co-founder and peace activist, John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', featuring a diverse range of styles.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped. An incredible, eclectic double album. Which deep cut is your go-to?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Death Anniversary
events.blurb: The world remembers Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who passed away in London.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?
